scope: MHA operator ablation; not full-model inference

metadata.scope: source-bound pre_attention plus local attention; no full engine or model
metadata.sample_definition: mean per call over iterations, then maximum across ranks; spread across round means
metadata.memory_definition: eager pre_attention peak allocated minus entry allocation; validation outputs freed

arms.baseline: unchanged base class: separate K/V gathers, batch-first
arms.layout_only: two separate gathers, each sequence-first and contiguous; transpose output views
arms.packing_only: batch-first stack K/V, one gather dim=1, unbind output views
arms.head: unchanged head class: sequence-first packed single gather
arms.head_contiguous: head helper, then materialize contiguous K and V outputs
